articles.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
articles.snippet: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

articles.title: Robinhood taps Ripple’s $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
articles.snippet: Robinhood helped launch a rival dollar-backed token, USDG, but will also offer Ripple's stablecoin to retail customers later this year.

articles.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
articles.snippet: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

articles.title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
articles.snippet: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.
